task: Grid convergence (BB fix) + BFS retest via common interface

test1_suboff_grid_convergence.description: SUBOFF bare hull, Re=1000, MRT+Smag(Cs=0.05), from_suboff normals, lbm_step_correct (BB fix)

analysis.bb_fix_solves_divergence: YES — L=160 is finite (was diverged without BB fix)
analysis.L160_high_error_cause: Only 3000 steps (vs 5000); higher Re; larger grid needs more time
analysis.lagrange_vs_standard: Lagrange is WORSE (12.2% vs 9.5% at L=40) and 10x slower (torch.roll shifts)

test2_bfs_retest.description: BFS, nx=400, ny=20, step_h=10, x_step=100, Re=1000, MRT+Smag, 10000 steps, parabolic inlet

analysis.recirculation_strength: Very weak (ux≈-7e-6 at x_step); grid may be too coarse

test3_couette_grid_convergence.description: 3D Couette, tau=1.0, moving top wall, lbm_step_correct with custom bounce_back_fn

analysis.bb_fix_improvement: 5-6x error reduction at ny=16 and ny=32
analysis.divergence_solved: PARTIALLY — error still grows but 5x slower (12.3%→2.41% at ny=32)
analysis.ny32_residual_cause: Insufficient steps: relaxation time ∝ H², ny=32 needs ~5400 steps but ran 4000

key_findings.1_bb_fix_prevents_divergence: YES — SUBOFF L=160 is finite (was diverged); Couette ny=32 error reduced 5x
key_findings.2_bb_fix_shows_convergence: YES for L=40→L=80 (9.5%→5.6%); L=160 needs more steps
key_findings.4_lagrange_vs_standard: Lagrange is WORSE (12.2% vs 9.5%) and 10x slower; standard recommended
key_findings.5_couette_residual: Error still grows with grid refinement but 5x slower; needs more steps for large grids
